title: Red team engagement plan
description: RedScanner v0.4.0 — triage.py manual verification (export/apply), HTTP method audit (WSTG-CONF-06), CORS/TLS/dirbust/CDN/header modules, SARIF export, --fail-on CI gating. Resume: python main.py --resume. Multi-target: --target-file targets.txt.
methodology_frameworks: NIST SP 800-115 — Technical Guide for Security Testing

manual_phases.name: August — RedScanner v0.4 (HTTP methods + CI/CD + triage)
tasks: HTTP method audit: python main.py --profile web-hardening (now includes http_methods; WSTG-CONF-06)
Confirm any TRACE/PUT/DELETE finding manually with curl -X <METHOD> before reporting to Blue Team
CI/CD gating: python main.py --profile full --fail-on high (exit code 2 when a high+ finding exists)
Consume report.sarif in GitHub code scanning / any SARIF-aware pipeline
Manual verification: python triage.py export output/<target>/<scan>/report.json — mark confirmed/false_positive, then triage.py apply
Full v0.4 pipeline: python main.py --profile full

manual_phases.name: June — RedScanner v0.3 new modules
tasks: CORS audit: python main.py --profile web-hardening (includes cors + tls + header_check)
CDN bypass test: python main.py --profile cdn-test (requires cdn_origin_ip in red_plan.json)
Directory enum: python main.py --profile discovery (recon + naabu + dirbust; install gobuster for full wordlist scan)
TLS assessment: add testssl.sh to PATH for comprehensive cipher/cert checks; openssl fallback runs automatically
Resume interrupted scan: python main.py --resume (reads resume.cfg written after each completed module)
Multi-target scan: python main.py --target-file targets.txt
Full v0.3 pipeline: python main.py --profile full

manual_phases.name: May — RedScanner v0.2 (CDN upgrade validation)
tasks: Quick header audit: python main.py --profile header-only
Vuln scan: april-vuln or full; tune nuclei_tags / nuclei_exclude_tags (default excludes dos,fuzz)
Regression: python scan_diff.py output/<target>/<old>/report.json output/<target>/<new>/report.json --output diff.json
CDN upgrade test scripts: ./run_all.sh on the 1.29.2.3 node (functional/performance/rollback)
Open items from CDN test: TLS 1.0 still accepted, WAF returns 904, X-Cache-Status missing

manual_phases.name: OSINT and passive mapping
tasks: Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh, Censys)
Shodan / Censys reconnaissance for origin IP
DNS zone walk / AXFR attempt
Google dork enumeration

manual_phases.name: Manual web application testing
tasks: Burp Suite / ZAP proxy interception
Authentication and session testing (JWT, session fixation)
Business logic flaw analysis
File upload and path traversal
CSRF, IDOR, privilege escalation
Verify 7 critical SQLi findings from March scan manually

manual_phases.name: CDN & infrastructure (manual follow-up)
tasks: HTTP smuggling (CL.TE / TE.CL) — h2c-smuggler or custom script
Cache poisoning — vary header manipulation, X-Forwarded-Host injection
WAF rule evaluation — test block_cause in naxsi.log for 904 responses
TLS downgrade — fix TLS 1.0/1.1 in ssl_protocols on 1.29.2.3 node
Rate-limit bypass testing

manual_phases.name: Post-exploitation (if in scope)
tasks: Credential reuse / lateral movement simulation
Data exfiltration proof-of-concept
Cloud metadata endpoint access
